concerns.text: T003 runs 'in code/src/audit/monte_carlo_validation.py' and compares against implementations that T001 relocates into code/src/audit/ (monte_carlo_core.py, stat_verification.py), yet the dependency list says 'T002, T003 may run in parallel with T001'. T003 cannot execute before T001's layout exists; also monte_carlo_validation.py is not in T001's enumerated module list, so its producer is ambiguous. Fix the dependency edge and add the module to T001's layout.

T013 requires a full re-run from 'data/input/urls.csv' to yield 'identical aggregate statistics (seeded)', but the pipeline fetches live web URLs whose content changes between runs; only the synthetic/Monte Carlo parts are seeded. As written the verification is not executable. Either scope the identical-statistics check to the seeded components, or specify a cached/frozen fetch layer (e.g., data/raw/ snapshots) that the re-run consumes.

T007 depends on 'the annotation protocol in docs/annotation_protocol.md', but no task produces that file (plan R03 only 'defines' it at plan level). Also 'two independent annotators and third-annotator resolution' names no producer — for an implementer/LLM execution loop, specify who/what performs annotation and where the protocol file is created, or the task is not self-contained.

T004 and T005 require sourcing real URL corpora (≥30, then ≥300 deduplicated) but neither task names where the URL list comes from or who curates it; T013 references 'data/input/urls.csv' as a declared input that no task writes. Add the corpus-sourcing step (file path, curation criteria) so the implementer can execute deterministically.

T011's verification includes 'the novice-verification step with a written confirmation log' (SC-028) but does not name who the novice is or where the confirmation log is written; an implementer cannot produce a 'novice user test' deterministically. Specify the log path and the substitute verification (e.g., timed fresh-runner execution) or mark the human-novice element explicitly.
